title: استراتيجية التدريس التأملي للأطفال
abstractText: يهدف البحث الحالي إلى التعرف على اتجاهات المعلمين نحو استخدام أدوات التدريس التأملي البصرية والرمزية في تنمية وعي الطفل بعملية تعلمه في المرحلة الأساسية، والكشف عن تقديراتهم لمستوى التفكير فوق المعرفي والتحصيل الأكاديمي لدى الأطفال عند استخدام هذه الأدوات، اعتمدت الباحثة المنهج الوصفي، مستخدمة أداة الاستبانة التي تضمنت (18) فقرة موزعة على مجالين رئيسين: اتجاهات المعلمين نحو التدريس التأملي باستخدام الأدوات البصرية والرمزية (9) فقرات، وتقديرات المعلمين لوعي الطفل والتفكير فوق المعرفي والتحصيل الأكاديمي (9) فقرات، فيما تكونت عينة الدراسة من(79) معلماً ومعلمة من معلمي المرحلة الأساسية في مدارس منطقة شرق القدس، تم اختيارهم بطريقة العينة العشوائية خلال الفصل الدراسي الثاني من العام الدراسي 2025/2026. وأظهرت النتائج أن اتجاهات المعلمين نحو استخدام الأدوات البصرية والرمزية في التدريس التأملي جاءت إيجابية وبدرجة كبيرة بمتوسط حسابي (3.71)، حيث برزت قناعة قوية لدى المعلمين بأن هذا النوع من التدريس يساعد الطفل على التفكير في "كيفية تعلمه" وليس فقط في المحتوى المعرفي، كما بينت النتائج أن تقديرات المعلمين لوعي الطفل وتفكيره فوق المعرفي كانت مرتفعة بمتوسط (3.72)، حيث لاحظ المعلمون أن الأطفال الذين يستخدمون الرسم والرموز يصبحون أكثر وعياً بخطوات تعلمهم وأكثر قدرة على مراجعة أخطائهم وتصحيحها بشكل مستقل، كما أوضحت النتائج عدم وجود فروق ذات دلالة إحصائية في اتجاهات المعلمين نحو هذه الاستراتيجية تعزى لمتغيرات الجنس، أو المؤهل العلمي، أو التخصص الأكاديمي، أو سنوات الخبرة، مما يشير إلى وجود توافق مهني عام حول فاعلية هذه الأدوات. وتوصي الدراسة بضرورة إعداد برامج تدريبية متخصصة للمعلمين لتمكينهم من توظيف الأدوات البصرية والرمزية بفاعلية أكبر، مع العمل على إدراج أنشطة الرسم والرموز ضمن المناهج الدراسية للمراحل المبكرة لدعم وعي الطفل واستقلاليته. وتنسجم هذه النتائج مع دراسات سابقة مثل دراسة عبد اللطيف (2020) ومشهور (2016)، وتقدم الدراسة بذلك إضافة علمية وعملية تسهم في تطوير طرائق التدريس بما يتناسب مع القدرات النمائية للأطفال، وتسد فجوة بحثية في الأدب التربوي حول "كيفية تفكير الطفل في تعلمه" عبر وسائط غير كتابية

title: Pengaruh Perencanaan Karier dan Efikasi Diri terhadap Kesiapan Kerja Peserta Pelatihan Berbasis Kompetensi di BLK Komunitas Miftahul Ulum Kota Tasikmalaya
abstractText: This study aims to analyze the effects of career planning and self-efficacy on the work readiness of participants in Competency-Based Training (CBT) at the Miftahul Ulum Community Vocational Training Center (BLK) in Tasikmalaya City. The study employed a quantitative approach with descriptive and verification methods, using a census technique involving 60 participants. Data were collected through a Likert-scale questionnaire and analyzed using multiple linear regression with the assistance of SPSS version 31 at a 5% significance level. The results indicate that career planning and self-efficacy simultaneously have a positive and significant effect on work readiness. Partially, both variables also have positive and significant effects on work readiness, with self-efficacy showing a relatively stronger effect. The model yielded an R value of 0.703 and an R² value of 0.494, indicating that 49.4% of the variation in work readiness can be explained by career planning and self-efficacy, while the remaining 50.6% is explained by other factors outside the model. The findings indicate the importance of integrating technical competency development, career planning, and self-efficacy enhancement in the implementation of vocational training programs.

title: Inequalities in quitting smoking and use of support among women by age and socioeconomic position: a population study in England
abstractText: Background Mid-life may be a particularly challenging period to quit smoking among women, especially those from less advantaged socioeconomic groups. Differences in quit attempt characteristics, use of evidence-based support, and nicotine dependence may contribute to lower quit success, but their relative importance remains unclear. Methods We analysed data from 7,791 women in the Smoking Toolkit Study (England, 2013–2026) who attempted to stop smoking in the past year. Age was categorised as younger (16–44 years), mid-life (45–60 years), and older (> 60 years), and social grade as more (ABC1) or less advantaged (C2DE). Logistic regression models examined differences in quit attempt characteristics (planned vs. unplanned, abrupt vs. gradual), use of evidence-based support (e-cigarettes, prescription nicotine replacement therapy, non-nicotine pharmacotherapy, face-to-face behavioural support), and quit success, adjusted for survey year and relevant covariates. Results Mid-life women had the lowest quit success (18.1%) compared with younger (22.3%) and older women (20.6%), with the lowest quit success observed among less advantaged mid-life women (15.8% vs. 25.2% among more advantaged younger women; adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 0.56, 95%CI 0.45–0.69). Yet, mid-life women were among the most likely to use evidence-based support (more advantaged: 45.8%; less advantaged: 47.4%), comparable to younger less advantaged women (46.4%) and higher than other groups (36.9–40.0%). Adjustment for quit attempt characteristics and use of evidence-based support had minimal impact on age-related differences in quit success. However, adjustment for nicotine dependence attenuated the lower odds of success in mid-life women. In fully adjusted models with younger more advantaged women as the reference category, less advantaged mid-life women had the lowest odds of quitting (aOR = 0.75, 95%CI 0.58–0.98), older more advantaged women had higher odds (aOR = 1.36, 95%CI 1.02–1.82), and differences for other groups were not evident (aORs 0.93–1.16). Conclusions Less advantaged mid-life women are the least likely to be successful in their attempts to stop smoking, despite relatively high uptake of evidence-based support. Higher nicotine dependence partly explains this disparity, but other factors also likely contribute and warrant further investigation.

title: Digitalisasi, Hospital Service Quality, dan Patient Continuity Intention: Peran Mediasi Patient Contentment Pada Pasien BPJS dan Non-BPJS Di Rumah Sakit Tipe B DKI Jakarta
abstractText: This study analyzes the influence of digitalization and hospital service quality on patient continuity intention, with patient satisfaction as a mediating variable among type B hospital patients in DKI Jakarta. The research design employs a causal quantitative approach with purposive sampling of 303 inpatients and outpatients who have utilized hospital services for at least one year. Data analysis is conducted using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with AMOS, including path estimates for the BPJS group (n=135) and Non-BPJS group (n=168). The results indicate that digitalization does not have a significant direct effect on patient continuity intention but positively influences patient satisfaction in the overall model and the BPJS group, while showing a significant negative effect in the Non-BPJS group. Hospital service quality negatively affects patient continuity intention in the overall model and BPJS group, but is not significant in the Non-BPJS group. Patient satisfaction is shown to mediate the effects of digitalization and hospital service quality on patient continuity intention. These findings underscore the importance of patient satisfaction in linking digital experiences and service quality.

title: Pengaruh E-Recruitment, Employee Branding, dan Kompensasi terhadap Intention to Apply for a Job
abstractText: Competition for qualified employees encourages companies to implement effective recruitment strategies through digital technology, corporate image development, and competitive compensation. This study aims to analyze the effects of e-recruitment, employee branding, and compensation on intention to apply for a job. A quantitative approach with a descriptive and verificative design was employed. The sample consisted of 250 respondents selected using a non-probability sampling technique with a purposive sampling method. Data were analyzed using IBM SPSS Statistics. The results indicate that e-recruitment, employee branding, and compensation have positive and significant effects on job application intention, both partially and simultaneously. The coefficient of determination of 78.6% indicates that the three variables explain the variation in job application intention, while the remaining 21.4% is influenced by other factors. These findings suggest that efficient digital recruitment systems, a positive corporate image, and fair, competitive compensation play important roles in increasing a company's attractiveness to prospective employees.

title: Strategi Pengembangan Laboratorium Simulasi Bisnis Menuju Smart Campus Guna Meningkatkan Work Readiness Politeknik Negeri Bengkalis
abstractText: This study aims to analyze the internal and external conditions of the Business Simulation Laboratory at Politeknik Negeri Bengkalis and to formulate development strategies towards a Smart Campus that supports the work readiness of Digital Business students. The research employs a qualitative descriptive approach with purposive sampling techniques. Data were collected through interviews, observations, documentation, and literature studies, involving five groups of informants: students, alumni, industry representatives, the Head of the Department, and the Head of the Study Program. Analysis was conducted using SWOT, IFAS, and EFAS methods. After normalizing the weights so that the total internal and external factors each reach 1.00, the IFAS score was obtained at 2.76 with a strength-weakness difference of +0.84, while the EFAS score was 2.81 with an opportunity-threat difference of +0.94. This position places the laboratory in Quadrant I and supports the formulation of SO strategies. Strategic priorities include the development of industry-based smart laboratories, integration of digital technologies relevant to the industry, simulation of real-world jobs, strengthening partnerships with industry and alumni, and learning that fosters adaptation to technology. These strategies are formulated as educational support to develop competencies relevant to the job market; the increase in work readiness after implementation has not been empirically tested.

title: From Coding to Creativity: Integrating Design Thinking into IT and Technology Education
abstractText: This study examines how the integration of Design Thinking into Information Technology (IT) and technology education can bridge technical programming skills and creative, human-centered problem-solving. Specifically, it explores how the five stages of Design Thinking empathizing, defining, ideating, prototyping, and testing shape students’ creative thinking, active engagement, and collaborative learning experiences. A qualitative research approach was employed, involving teachers, students, and school principals as key informants. Data were collected through in-depth interviews, classroom observations, and documentation of learning activities, then analyzed thematically to identify recurring patterns in teaching practices and student experiences. The findings indicate that Design Thinking creates opportunities for students to move beyond coding procedures toward developing digital solutions that respond to real users’ needs. Through collaborative ideation, iterative prototyping, and feedback-based testing, students demonstrate greater involvement in learning, explore alternative solutions, and communicate their ideas more actively. The approach also provides opportunities to develop empathy, creativity, collaboration, and a willingness to experiment with and revise initial designs. Meanwhile, teachers assume a facilitative role by guiding inquiry, supporting experimentation, and connecting technical knowledge with authentic problems. This study highlights the pedagogical value of integrating Design Thinking into technology education as a framework for connecting computational competencies with human-centered innovation. Its implications emphasize the importance of designing learning activities that balance technical proficiency, creative exploration, and meaningful student participation.

title: The Pristine Survey. XXX. Mapping substructures in the inner and outer halo with blue horizontal branch stars
abstractText: Blue horizontal branch (BHB) stars serve as good standard candles and kinematic tracers of the Milky Way halo. The halo displays various overdensities and kinematical substructures of different shapes and sizes. Our objective is to investigate the substructure in three dimensions and the bulk motion of the halo up to distances well exceeding the limit of the parallaxes. Gaia We selected BHB stars in the łeft(u-CaHK̊ight) _ 0-$(g-r) _ 0$ colour-colour diagram with a hierarchical Bayesian mixture model of three populations: BHB stars, blue straggler stars, and outliers. Using CaHK photometry derived from XP spectra and the Pristine survey, we provide both a shallow and a deep catalogue of BHB stars of 7,057 and 8,824 stars, respectively, where the deep catalogue is restricted to the deeper Pristine footprint compared to the shallower with XP. Using the shallow catalogue, we trace to larger distances 6D substructures identified earlier within a 2.5 kpc from the Sun, including accepted populations; namely, Gaia-Enceladus, Thamnos, Helmi streams, Sequoia, and other smaller halo substructures such as ED-3, ED-4, and ED-6. The deep catalogue provides reliable distance measurements for a more detailed 3D mapping of the Sagittarius stream and of the Pisces Overdensity. We add new candidate BHB stars with line-of-sight velocities to existing catalogues and confirm previously reported differences between the northern and southern Galactic hemispheres, likely due to the infall of the Large Magellanic Cloud. Gaia Gaia This research demonstrates that probabilistic photometric classification can effectively identify distant candidate BHB stars, and can provide catalogues of these stars that enhance our understanding of the 3D and 6D structures in the halo of the Milky Way.

title: Analisis Efektivitas Sosialisasi Visi dan Misi di Magister Manajemen FEB Universitas Trisakti
abstractText: Vision, Mission, Goals, and Objectives (VMTS) are fundamental strategic elements in the governance of higher education institutions that guide the implementation of the Tridharma and ensure academic quality. This study aims to analyze the effectiveness of VMTS socialization and evaluate the most effective communication channels according to stakeholders in the Master of Management Study Program at FEB Universitas Trisakti. This descriptive quantitative research uses a survey method with a 5-point Likert scale questionnaire. The research respondents consist of 78 stakeholders, including students, lecturers, educational staff, and alumni/graduates' users. The results of this study indicate that the majority of respondents have heard, known, and understood the Vision, Mission, Goals, and Objectives of the Master of Management Study Program at Universitas Trisakti. The findings show that the level of understanding among the academic community regarding VMTS is categorized as very high, with 88.5% of respondents understanding the vision, 89.7% understanding the mission, and 87.2% understanding the goals and objectives of the study program. As many as 84.6% of respondents assess that VMTS has been implemented in academic operational activities. In terms of communication channels, direct socialization (face-to-face/Zoom) is rated as the most effective (72.4%), followed by social media (60.7%) and the official website (40.5%). The implications of this study demand that program managers implement a hybrid communication strategy (omnichannel communication) that combines the interactive strengths of direct media with the broad reach of digital media to maintain the sustainability of VMTS understanding.

title: Pengaruh Gaya Kepemimpinan, Kepuasan Kerja, dan Motivasi terhadap Kinerja di RS Bunda Sejati
abstractText: The performance of healthcare workers is an important component in supporting the achievement of quality healthcare services in hospitals. Such performance can be influenced by various factors, including leadership style, job satisfaction, and motivation. This study aimed to analyze the effects of leadership style, job satisfaction, and motivation on the performance of healthcare workers at Bunda Sejati Hospital, Tangerang. This study employed a quantitative approach with a descriptive research design. The sample consisted of 100 healthcare workers at Bunda Sejati Hospital, Tangerang. Data were collected using a Likert-scale questionnaire and analyzed using multiple linear regression, t-test, F-test, and coefficient of determination. The results showed that leadership style had a positive and significant effect on healthcare workers’ performance, with a t-value of 2.906 and a significance value of 0.005. Job satisfaction also had a positive and significant effect on performance, with a t-value of 2.241 and a significance value of 0.027. Motivation had a positive and significant effect on performance, with a t-value of 3.160 and a significance value of 0.002. Simultaneously, leadership style, job satisfaction, and motivation had a significant effect on healthcare workers’ performance, with an F-value of 67.162 and a significance value of 0.000. The Adjusted R Square value of 0.667 indicates that 66.7% of the variation in healthcare workers’ performance could be explained by the three independent variables, while the remaining 33.3% was explained by other factors outside the research model. Therefore, leadership style, job satisfaction, and motivation are significant factors associated with the performance of healthcare workers at Bunda Sejati Hospital, Tangerang.

Analisis Manajemen Digital Marketing Berdasarkan Internal Factor Analysis Summary (IFAS) Dan External Factor Analysis Summary (EFAS) Pada Arba Digital Global
abstractText: This study analyzes the digital marketing management of Arba Digital Global by mapping internal and external factors using the Internal Factor Analysis Summary (IFAS) and External Factor Analysis Summary (EFAS), focusing on the marketing of geronggang oil products through marketplaces. A descriptive qualitative approach with a case study design was employed. Initial data were obtained through observations of the Shopee store display, documentation of account appearances, identification of promotional activities, and strategic assessments of strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, and threats. The mapping results indicated an internal strength of 1.74 and a weakness of 1.02, yielding an IFAS score of 2.76 with an internal coordinate of +0.72. For external factors, opportunities were valued at 1.92 and threats at 0.84, resulting in an EFAS score of 2.76 with an external coordinate of +1.08. This positioning places Arba Digital Global in Quadrant I (Growth/Progressive), recommending an SO strategy. Priorities for digital marketing management include enhancing social commerce, optimizing video content, utilizing affiliates, developing CRM, diversifying product bundling, and employing analytics to measure performance.

title: Perancangan UI/UX Mobile Health Extended e-iANC Berbasis Android
abstractText: The use of digital technology in maternal health services can help health workers deliver care more efficiently. Access to Extended e-iANC, which was originally web-based, is less flexible, so a UI/UX design for an Android-based mobile health application is needed that aligns with the needs and workflow of midwives at Independent Midwife Practices (Tempat Praktik Mandiri Bidan, TPMB) in West Jakarta. The study employed the Research and Development (R&D) method with the Double Diamond Design framework, covering the Discover, Define, Develop, and Deliver stages. User needs were gathered through interviews with three midwives, while the usability evaluation used the System Usability Scale (SUS) with eight midwives. The result is an Android-based UI/UX design for the Extended e-iANC mobile health application, covering improvements to the ANC and childbirth flow, SATUSEHAT integration, midwife–patient consultation, and notifications and reminders. The evaluation yielded a SUS score of 81.25, categorized as Acceptable, Grade A, and Adjective Rating Excellent. The score indicates that the design is acceptable to users and offers good usability. The study covers only the design and usability evaluation and does not extend to direct application implementation. The resulting design can serve as a basis for system development and integration in the next stage.

title: The spatial structure of solar magnetoconvection at scales up to 60 Mm.
abstractText: While convective motions at the scale of granules on the solar surface are well understood, those of mesogranular and supergranulation are not. At still larger scales, the lack of giant cells is a major mystery. We aim to slightly improve understanding of the radial and horizontal flows associated with mesogranular scales and supergranulation. We performed a deep MURaM small-scale dynamo simulation, extending from 50 Mm below the solar surface and with a horizontal size of 60 Mm and sufficient resolution to begin to properly resolve the magnetic bright points in intergranular lanes. We determined the structure of the convective modes from the simulations at different scales, and compared the power spectra to those which have been previously observed. At all scales that are resolved by the simulation, the simulated flows agree with the amplitude implied by Doppler measurements and local correlation tracking measurements. The power in the vertical Doppler velocities at supergranular and larger scales is shown to be affected by density perturbations near the surface. The structure of the modes at depth is simple, as expected from previous studies, except the horizontal forcing scale scales as H_̊ho^2/3 instead of H̊ho. The simulations reproduce the observations up to scales of 60 Mm. Within the simulated range, l>=70, no excess power associated with the convective conundrum is detected.

title: Kepatuhan Masa Simpan Data KIA dan Aksesibilitas Data PMB
abstractText: Data from Maternal and Child Health (MCH) services play a crucial role in supporting the continuity of services, documentation, reporting, and fulfilling health information needs. Inadequate management of data retention periods can hinder the discovery and accessibility of data. This study aims to determine the effect of midwives' compliance with the data retention period of MCH services on the accessibility of data from Independent Midwife Practices (IMP). The research was conducted using a quantitative analytical approach with a cross-sectional design involving 62 midwives selected through non-probability sampling using accidental sampling methods. Data were collected using a questionnaire and analyzed through univariate analysis and logistic regression with a significance level of 0.05. A total of 57 respondents (91.9%) demonstrated low compliance with the data retention period for MCH, while 53 respondents (85.5%) had low data accessibility. The results of the logistic regression analysis indicated a significant effect between compliance with the data retention period of MCH and data accessibility (p = 0.012; OR = 12.750; 95% CI = 1.762–92.261). Compliance with the data retention period of MCH significantly influences the accessibility of IMP data. Strengthening data retention management and data governance is necessary to improve the accessibility of MCH data. This study is limited to 62 respondents from eight IMPs using accidental sampling techniques, thus generalization of results should be done with caution.

title: Klasterisasi Karakteristik Pengguna E-Commerce Berdasarkan Profil Pengguna Menggunakan Algoritma K-Prototypes
abstractText: Accurate customer segmentation supports more personalized e-commerce marketing. However, the Recency, Frequency, Monetary (RFM) model focuses on transaction history and may not fully capture shopping motivation or the share of a consumer’s spending allocated to e-commerce (Share of Wallet/SoW). This study aims to cluster e-commerce users based on transaction profiles and consumer behavior using the K-Prototypes algorithm. Data were collected from 198 e-commerce users in Palembang, Indonesia. The clustering variables included RFM, SoW, shopping motivation, and product-category preferences, while age category was used for follow-up analysis. The Elbow Method and Silhouette Score supported a four-cluster solution. The resulting personas were High-Value Promo Hunters, Routine Pragmatic Shoppers, Passive Micro-Spenders, and Urgent Big-Ticket Buyers. The Chi-square test indicated a significant association between age category and persona, with Cramér’s V of 0.274. This suggests that age is associated with shopping patterns but does not fully determine consumer profiles. The findings can inform more targeted promotions and user-experience design. The study is limited to 198 respondents from Palembang, so the findings may not represent e-commerce users in other regions.

title: Pathogenetic relationship of intestinal microbiota and microbial metabolome with chronic kidney diseases
abstractText: The modern concept of the “pathogenetic intestine–kidney axis” reflects the connection between the state of the gut microbiome and the development of chronic kidney disease (CKD). Intestinal dysbiosis, caused by various factors, manifests itself as a change in the quantitative and qualitative composition of the microflora, with disruption of production of its metabolites, which are involved in regulating important metabolic and energy processes in the body. Among the most significant of these are short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), which are formed as a result of bacterial fermentation of indigestible dietary fiber. The effects mediated by SCFAs have not only a local but also a systemic impact. By affecting the permeability of the intestinal mucosa and its peristalsis, the secretion of intestinal hormones, immune activity, and other regulatory mechanisms—including the maintenance of blood pressure—SCFAs ensure the normal functioning of individual organs and systems. In CKD, disruption of the intestinal microbiocenosis is associated with a decrease in the diversity of microorganisms, including commensal ones, which leads to a reduction in the production of key SCFAs and causes disruptions in lipid and carbohydrate metabolism, immune regulation, and the development of inflammatory processes. Against this backdrop, in patients suffering from CKD, as kidney function declines, there is an accumulation of other products of bacterial metabolism, such as indole derivatives, phenols, and others, which, due to their toxic effect, contribute not only to further kidney damage but also to the accelerated development of atherosclerosis and the emergence of cardiovascular complications. The review analyzes and systematizes the results of studies conducted by domestic and foreign authors on the state of the gut microbiome, the spectrum of SCFAs, and other metabolites in patients suffering from CKD, since this problem is relevant not only in terms of clarifying the mechanisms of pathogenesis of this condition but also in assessing the potential of therapeutic approaches aimed at slowing the progression of renal function loss by restoring the normal composition of the gut microbiota.

title: Analisis Perbedaan Tarif Rumah Sakit, Tarif INA-CBG’s, dan Tarif IDRG pada Pasien Diabetes Melitus Tipe 2 Rawat Inap di RS X
abstractText: Hospital tariffs refer to healthcare service costs determined based on all services provided to patients. Under the National Health Insurance (Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional/JKN) program, claim payments utilize the Indonesia Case Base Groups (INA-CBGs) system. The government has also begun piloting the Indonesian Diagnosis Related Groups (iDRG) as an improvement to the INA-CBGs system. This study aimed to analyze the differences between hospital tariffs, INA-CBGs tariffs, and iDRG tariffs for hospitalized patients with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus at Hospital X. A quantitative method with a cross-sectional design was employed, involving a sample of 60 patients selected through total sampling. Data were obtained from patient claims and analyzed using the Friedman test to examine the simultaneous differences among the three tariffs. The results indicated that the mean hospital tariff was IDR 11,017,297.55, the mean INA-CBGs tariff was IDR 5,420,666.67, and the mean iDRG tariff was IDR 6,625,216.32. The Friedman test revealed a significant difference among the three tariffs (p < 0.001). The mean difference between the hospital tariff and INA-CBGs tariff was IDR 5,596,630.88, between the hospital tariff and iDRG tariff was IDR 4,392,081.23, and between the INA-CBGs tariff and iDRG tariff was IDR 1,204,549.65. These findings indicate that the fee-for-service hospital tariff is higher than the bundled INA-CBGs and iDRG tariffs.

title: Perancangan Prototipe Sertifikat Kematian Elektronik di Rumah Sakit Pusat Otak Nasional Prof. Dr. dr. Mahar Mardjono Jakarta
abstractText: The management of death certificates at RS PON Prof. Dr. dr. Mahar Mardjono Jakarta remains constrained by manual documentation, administrative workload, illegible handwriting, and delays in information provision, potentially affecting the quality and use of mortality data. This study aimed to identify user needs, design a user interface (UI), develop a web-based electronic death certificate prototype, and evaluate its usability. A Research and Development (R&D) approach was employed using a development model adapted from ADDIE, comprising needs analysis, design, prototype development, and usability testing. Informants were selected through purposive sampling and comprised 3 doctors, 3 nurses, 3 medical records officers, 3 mortuary service staff, and 3 cashiers, totaling 15 informants. Data were collected through interviews, observation, and document review. The findings indicated that users required role-based information access, efficient data entry, and features for certificate management, verification, and printing. The prototype was developed to accommodate the operational needs of each user group. Usability testing using the System Usability Scale (SUS) yielded a score of 84.3, categorized as excellent. The prototype may serve as an initial design to support electronic death certificate management in accordance with user needs.

title: ALMA detection of continuum emission from GQ Lup B
abstractText: GQ Lup B is a massive (10-40 M_ Jup ) companion orbiting the young T-Tauri star GQ Lup A at a projected distance of ∼110 au (0.7''). It lies outside the circumprimary disk in the submillimeter continuum , but its ∼,63^̧irc inclined orbit intersects the primary's gas disk twice per period. We report a 5.8σ detection of continuum emission at the location of GQ Lup B, obtained with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) at 0.89 mm (band 7). We associate this emission with a dusty disk around the companion, already detected by VLT/NACO and JWST/MIRI in the mid-infrared. To date, this is the third disk observed at millimeter wavelengths around a companion spanning the brown dwarf and planetary mass regimes , following PDS 70 c, a gas giant embedded in the parent circumstellar disk, and SR 12 c, a planetary mass companion at 1200 au from the primary. We retrieve a point source with a peak intensity of 54.5 , co-spatial with GRAVITY astrometry. The emission is spatially unresolved, Jy, beam^ -1 placing an upper limit of 2.3 au on the source radius (from a synthesized beam of ∼,29 disks. mas). For comparison, this is smaller than 1/3 of the Hill radius (3-5 au for GQ Lup B, depending on the assumed mass), the theoretical upper limit for circumplanetary Assuming optically thin thermal emission from millimeter-sized grains in a disk-like structure , we infer a mass of 0.0032 M_⊕, while the optically thick limit yields an emission radius of 0.2 au. Assuming a gas-to-dust ratio of 100, our results indicate a very low disk-mass-to-accretion-rate ratio, on the order of sim10^4 yr, analogously to the highest accretors in the stellar mass regime. In the case of GQ Lup B, this can be explained by its periodic crossing of the circumprimary disk, which could deliver a substantial amount of gas to the companion's disk over a long timescale.

title: Pengaruh Green Innovation Terhadap Purchase Intention Melalui Environmental Awareness dan Green Brand Image Pada Konsumen Muda Kopi Janji Jiwa di Samarinda
abstractText: This study examines the effect of Green Innovation on Purchase Intention through Environmental Awareness and Green Brand Image among young Kopi Janji Jiwa consumers in Samarinda. A quantitative approach with a cross-sectional design was employed using the Stimulus-Organism-Response (S-O-R) framework. Data were collected through questionnaires from 360 respondents aged 17–30 who had purchased Kopi Janji Jiwa at an outlet in Samarinda within the previous six months. Data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS 4. The study's novelty lies in examining Environmental Awareness and Green Brand Image as parallel mediators in a single model. The results indicate that Green Innovation positively and significantly affects Environmental Awareness, Green Brand Image, and Purchase Intention. Both mediators also positively and significantly affect Purchase Intention and mediate the relationship between Green Innovation and Purchase Intention. The indirect effect through Green Brand Image is greater than that through Environmental Awareness. These findings suggest that Kopi Janji Jiwa should strengthen environmentally friendly innovations and communicate sustainability practices transparently to build a credible green brand image and support purchase intention among young consumers.

title: Pengaruh Personalisasi Rekomendasi Produk Terhadap Perilaku Pembelian Konsumen Dengan Trust Sebagai Variabel Mediasi Pada Pengguna Shopee
abstractText: Product recommendation personalization helps e-commerce platform users find products that match their needs and preferences. This study examines the effect of Product Recommendation Personalization on Trust, the effect of Trust on Purchase Behavior, and the mediating role of Trust among Shopee users based on the Stimulus–Organism–Response (S-O-R) framework. A quantitative approach with a cross-sectional design was employed. Data were collected through an online questionnaire using purposive sampling, resulting in 111 eligible respondents, comprising 72.07% male and 27.93% female respondents aged 14–69 years. The data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) in SmartPLS 4 with 5,000 bootstrap subsamples. The results indicate that Product Recommendation Personalization has a positive and significant effect on Trust (β = 0.696; p < 0.001). Trust also has a positive and significant effect on Purchase Behavior (β = 0.719; p < 0.001). The indirect effect of Product Recommendation Personalization on Purchase Behavior through Trust is also significant (β = 0.501; p < 0.001), confirming the mediating role of Trust. These findings support the S-O-R mechanism and highlight the importance of recommendation relevance and user trust in supporting online purchasing behavior.

title: Analisis Kelayakan Ekonomi Penerapan Rekam Medis Elektronik Menggunakan Metode Benefit Cost Ratio
abstractText: The implementation of Electronic Medical Records (EMR) requires ongoing operational costs (ongoing cost), making it necessary to evaluate the economic benefits generated. This study aimed to describe the operational costs and tangible benefits of EMR implementation and to analyze the Benefit Cost Ratio (BCR) of EMR implementation at the National Brain Center Hospital Prof. Dr. dr. Mahar Mardjono. This quantitative study was conducted at the Medical Records Unit and Hospital Information Systems Unit from December 2025 to June 2026, using document review as the data collection method. The results showed that the total operational costs (ongoing cost) for the 2020-2025 period amounted to IDR 1,415,969,150. The tangible benefits consisted of cost displacement amounting to IDR 2,547,842,757 and cost avoidance amounting to IDR 80,000,000, with a total of IDR 2,627,842,757. The BCR of 1.86 indicates that the tangible benefits were greater than the operational costs. Therefore, the BCR of 1.86 does not represent the overall economic feasibility of EMR implementation but is limited to the comparison between tangible benefits and operational costs.

title: Intermediate-redshift slow rotators as the progenitors of the most massive galaxies at z ∼ 0
abstractText: We study the resolved stellar kinematics and star formation histories, as well as their dependence on the environment, based on a sample of 218 intermediate-redshift (0.1 < z łesssim 1) galaxies located in the CANDELS and COSMOS fields, observed with VLT/MUSE. The sample covers galaxies with stellar masses across the range M_⋆ ∼ 10 8 $ - 10^12 M_⊙, including both star-forming and quiescent systems. For 113 galaxies, found in dense environments of galaxy groups, we derived the spin parameter (λ_R), while for the rest of the sample, we used data from previous papers in this series. Given that the surveys used in this work are flux-limited, the λ_R distribution of our full sample lacks the bimodality observed in the Local Universe, but the subsample of galaxies at z < 0.6 resembles the galaxy population in the nearby Universe, in terms of mass, sizes, and stellar population properties; in particular, the resemblance is more significant than in comparison to galaxies at z > 0.6. We classified the galaxies into fast and slow rotators, finding that ∼8$%$ (17/218) of the galaxies are slow-rotating. The fraction of slow rotators does not change significantly down to z = 0, but we find that in the z ∼ 0 sample, the spin parameter is, on average, higher than at higher redshifts. In our subsample at z > 0.6, we observed evidence of the existence of the kinematic morphology-density relation. The slow rotators in our sample mostly assemble their stellar mass in one or two main episodes of formation and they finished assembling their mass via star formation by redshift of z ∼ 1. However, it is not clear if the loss of angular momentum can be associated with the last star formation episode. Based on their location in the mass-size diagram, the intermediate-redshift galaxies are consistent with being the progenitors of the most massive slow rotators observed at z $∼ 0, where the subsequent growth is facilitated through gas-poor (dry) mergers.

title: Analisis Komparatif Pola Pembelian Konsumen Marketplace pada Periode Weekdays dan Weekends Menggunakan Algoritma FP-Growth
abstractText: Product purchasing patterns on e-commerce platforms can be studied through transaction times, such as differentiating between weekdays and weekends. This study aims to compare product association patterns in the household goods category during weekdays and weekends using the FP-Growth algorithm, while evaluating their recommendation performance using Top-K metrics. Knowledge Discovery in Databases (KDD)-based processing was applied to e-commerce transaction data, yielding 17,039 clean records from an initial dataset of 20,848 raw data, consisting of 12,898 weekday transactions (75.7%) and 4,141 weekend transactions (24.3%). Association patterns were extracted using the FP-Growth algorithm, and recommendation performance was evaluated at K = 1, 3, 5. The results indicate differences in product characteristics; weekdays are dominated by combinations of daily necessity products (maximum Lift 4.1226), whereas weekends exhibit a wider variety of combinations (maximum Lift 4.2135). Testing identifies K = 3 as the optimal parameter, with F1-Score@3 values of 0.0445 for weekdays and 0.0814 for weekends. Findings from the implementation of FP-Growth and Top-K present association structures and objective recommendation performance, serving as a technical reference in implementing product recommendation system strategies.

title: Pengaruh Ulasan Pelanggan Online dan Persepsi Harga terhadap Niat Beli Konsumen Sudut Kedai di Metland Transyogi
abstractText: A sharp increase in menu prices at Sudut Kedai, coupled with shifting customer engagement online, raises a fundamental question: do online reviews and price perception actually influence purchase intention? This study examines both factors among Sudut Kedai consumers in Metland Transyogi. Questionnaires were distributed to 120 respondents who had read online reviews of Sudut Kedai, selected through convenience sampling. Data analysis was conducted using Partial Least Squares-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS 3.0. Online customer reviews demonstrate a positive and significant effect on purchase intention (path coefficient 0.245; T-statistic 3.271; p 0.001), as does price perception (path coefficient 0.373; T-statistic 4.861; p 0.000), with an R-Square of 0.220. Credible and informative reviews build buyer trust; prices perceived as proportional to quality enhance purchase intention. Sudut Kedai needs to actively manage customer reviews and maintain fair pricing to strengthen purchase intention amid an increasingly competitive culinary market.

title: Analisis Peran Moderasi Dukungan Organisasi dalam Pengaruh Kompetensi dan Komitmen Organisasi terhadap Kinerja Manajerial
abstractText: Managerial performance is one of the important factors determining organizational success because it relates to individuals’ abilities in planning, decision-making, coordinating work, and evaluating organizational activities. Improving managerial performance is influenced not only by individual capabilities but also by employees’ attachment to the organization and the support provided by the organization. This study aims to analyze the effect of competence and organizational commitment on managerial performance with organizational support as a moderating variable. The study employed a quantitative approach with an explanatory research design. The respondents consisted of 76 individuals holding managerial positions, selected using a saturated sampling technique. Data were collected through questionnaires using a five-point Likert scale and analyzed using Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with the Partial Least Square (PLS) approach through SmartPLS 3.3. The results show that competence and organizational commitment have a positive and significant effect on managerial performance. Organizational support is proven to strengthen the relationship between competence and organizational commitment toward managerial performance. The findings indicate the importance of developing individual capabilities and creating organizational support to improve managerial performance.

title: Determinasi Brand Evangelism Hasil Personalisasi, Influencer–Brand Fit, Dan Perceived Authenticity Melalui Consumer Trust
abstractText: The emergence of social media as a marketing tool has transformed consumer behavior toward brands. This study aims to analyze the effects of personalization level, influencer–brand fit, and perceived authenticity on brand evangelism, with consumer trust as a mediating variable. This study employs a quantitative approach through a survey of 268 social media users selected using a purposive sampling technique. Data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares–Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with the SmartPLS software. The results show that personalization level, perceived authenticity, and consumer trust have a positive effect on brand evangelism. In addition, personalization level, influencer–brand fit, and perceived authenticity have a positive effect on consumer trust. However, influencer–brand fit does not have a significant direct effect on brand evangelism. These findings underscore the importance of personalization, authenticity, and consumer trust in driving brand evangelism on social media.

title: Economic evaluation of a nutrition and physical activity intervention delivered in Early Childhood Education and Care (ECEC) for 2–5-year-olds in England and Scotland: the NAPSACC UK cluster randomised controlled trial
abstractText: Background In the UK around 14% of children live with obesity when they start primary school. Interventions which target dietary and physical activity behaviours in Early Childhood Education and Care (ECEC) settings could address this public health challenge. The Nutrition and Physical Activity Self-Assessment for Child Care (NAPSACC) programme was developed in the USA. The NAPSACC UK trial evaluated NAPSACC adapted for the UK. We report the cost-effectiveness of NAPSACC UK compared to usual practice. Methods ECEC providers in England and Scotland were randomised (25 intervention, 27 control) in a cluster-randomised controlled trial. The intervention was delivered over 12-months by trained ‘partners’ and included: self-assessment of practice; staff training workshops in physical activity and nutrition; and goal setting and action planning cycles to improve practice. Public health and ECEC provider costs of the intervention were estimated using partner records and ECEC cost impact questionnaires. Co-primary outcomes of total physical activity and total energy consumed on the days the child attended ECEC were measured using accelerometers and remote food photography. Parents/carers reported children’s quality of life, and weekly costs of physical activity and food. Results Nineteen (76%) ECEC providers completed one or more intervention cycle. The cost of the intervention was £2,590 per ECEC provider or £62.74 per eligible child at baseline. Eighty six percent of the costs (£2215 / £2590) were incurred by the ECEC provider. The intervention had a low probability of being cost-effective at reducing physical activity levels compared to usual practice. However, compared to usual practice the intervention had potential to be cost-effective for reducing calorie intake. If public health and ECEC providers were willing to devote £30 per child to achieve a meaningful reduction in calorie intake (10 kcal per ECEC day), the probability that the intervention is cost-effective compared to usual practice exceeds 95%. Conclusions Compared to usual practice, the intervention was unlikely to be cost-effective for improving physical activity and, despite some evidence of lower energy intake, it would not be appropriate for policy makers to use NAPSACC UK more widely in its current form. Trial registration UK Clinical Study Registry: ISRCTN33134697. Date: 31/10/2019.

title: Faktor Penentu Keputusan Investasi Generasi Z Di Pontianak
abstractText: This study examines whether financial literacy and media exposure are associated with the investment decisions of Generation Z in Pontianak City. The researchers distributed questionnaires to 154 respondents aged 17–29 who lived in Pontianak, had personal income, and had invested, or were currently investing, in the capital market. Respondents were selected using purposive sampling. The data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS, and the measurement model met the criteria for validity and reliability. The results show that both financial literacy and media exposure have a positive and significant relationship with investment decisions, although the effect sizes are small. Because the survey was conducted at a single point in time, these findings indicate association and do not establish causation. Organizers of investment education programs for young people are advised to develop participants’ financial skills while also paying attention to their media habits.

title: Системный анализ моделей рекомендательных систем с учётом изменения предпочтений пользователя
abstractText: Цель работы – сопоставить способы представления истории взаимодействий в рекомендательных моделях при изменении предпочтений пользователя. Проведён целевой аналитический обзор классических и нейросетевых подходов по сохранению порядка событий, временных интервалов и механизмам обновления. Предложен порядок выбора представления для последующей проверки качества, а его основания и ограничения показаны на расчётном примере. Результаты задают основу для планирования эксперимента и не устанавливают универсально лучшую архитектуру.

title: Comparative Performance Analysis of Sparse Recovery Algorithms
abstractText: Over the past five years, the compressed sensing (CS) recovery has increased considerably owing to its applications in the fifth-generation (5G) and sixth-generation (6G) massive Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) channel estimation. Moreover reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS) has emerged as an essential framework for 6G wireless communication systems. This limitation results in a highly underdetermined estimation problem, exacerbated by the large dimensionality of the IRS-induced channel matrices and the necessity to estimate the cascaded base station (BS) IRS user equipment (UE) links. The main concept behind Compressed Sensing is that of recovering sparse signals from much fewer observations under some specific conditions. This idea is exploited to develop a variety of recovery algorithms applied in signal processing and wireless communications. This paper presents a systematic comparative study of three CS-based recovery algorithms: Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP), Structured Matching Pursuit (StrMP), and Dictionary-based Sparse Bayesian Learning (DSBL). To evaluate the system performance, Normalized Mean Square Error (NMSE) and runtime over Monte Carlo trials are used. The simulation results show that the OMP outperformed DSBL at all SNR values. On the other hand DSBL does not offer competitive accuracy in this setting, but its automatic sparsity estimation remains an advantage when is unknown.. StrMP failed under random sparsity. Connections to deep unfolding and Bayesian generative models are discussed.

title: Precise deep-learning reconstruction of galaxy cluster mass maps and substructures from optical observations
abstractText: Accurately mapping the total mass distribution within galaxy clusters, including dark matter, is fundamental to understanding structure formation and constraining cosmological parameters. Standard mass mapping relies almost exclusively on gravitational lensing, which often yields smooth distributions based on analytical profiles, thereby missing critical internal substructures. We introduce a complementary, simulation-based inference approach to reconstruct detailed galaxy cluster mass maps and resolve internal substructures directly from optical imaging. We trained deep learning models on realistic hydro-simulated galaxy clusters to interpret observed cluster images. This framework was then applied to observations of real galaxy clusters obtained by the Hubble Space Telescope (HST) as part of the Cluster Lensing And Supernova survey with Hubble (CLASH) program. The reconstructed mass maps successfully reproduce the overall shapes and radial mass profiles of the CLASH clusters, showing strong agreement with independent gravitational lensing measurements. Using the subhalos derived from these reconstructed maps, we find that their mass functions exhibit a power-law behavior broadly consistent with predictions from numerical simulations. Our results demonstrate that combining optical imaging with deep learning provides a scalable, physically meaningful approach to mapping cluster masses. This framework opens a new avenue for utilizing upcoming wide-field imaging surveys to systematically study dark matter substructures, complementing traditional lensing techniques across much larger samples. Furthermore, the model is inherently flexible and can integrate multiwavelength data, such as X-ray and Sunyaev-Zeldovich observations, to further improve total mass predictions.

title: Kualitas Pencatatan Rekam Medis ANC Berdasarkan Komponen 10T di TPMB Jakarta Barat
abstractText: Antenatal care (ANC) data quality underpins continuity of pregnancy monitoring and the evidence base for maternal health programme evaluation, yet independent midwife practices (Tempat Praktik Mandiri Bidan, TPMB), which are often the first point of contact for pregnant women, are rarely assessed. Preliminary observation in West Jakarta found that only 1,439 of 2,693 visits (53.4%) had complete data. This study aimed to assess the quality of ANC medical record documentation (10T components) at TPMBs in West Jakarta and to explore the behavioural factors among midwives behind it. A mixed-methods design was used: a document review of 30 medical records from six TPMBs (quota sampling) against four AHIMA Data Quality Management dimensions as the main component, and in-depth interviews with seven midwives guided by the Theory of Planned Behavior. Accuracy was 79.44%, accessibility 59.71%, comprehensiveness 62.48%, and consistency 48.20%, with an overall mean of 62.45%. Documentation of case management (danger-sign screening) fell from 66.67% in the first trimester to 0% in the third, while tetanus toxoid immunization screening and laboratory testing were among the least documented components. All midwives reported performing every 10T component. Informants mentioned documentation workload and laboratory tests performed at primary health centres as barriers to documentation. ANC medical record documentation at TPMBs in West Jakarta remains inadequate, particularly for consistency and case management, indicating a need for standardised 10T forms, documentation training, and regular supervision.

title: Publicatie van kwartaalinformatie door beursgenoteerde ondernemingen
abstractText: Ten behoeve van investeringsbeslissingen hebben beleggers tijdig voldoende actuele informatie nodig. Daarom volstaat slechts de jaarrekening niet altijd en rapporteren ondernemingen ook tussentijdse informatie. In de Verenigde Staten is aangekondigd om in plaats van de huidige kwartaalinformatie slechts nog rapportage op halfjaarlijkse basis te verplichten; een situatie die in de Europese Unie al langer bestaat. In dit onderzoek laten we zien welke keuzes Nederlandse en Duitse ondernemingen maken ten aanzien van periodieke informatieverschaffing bij afwezigheid van een wettelijke verplichting daartoe. Het onderzoek laat zien dat de meeste ondernemingen op vrijwillige basis kwartaalinformatie verschaffen, maar dat grote diversiteit waarneembaar is in de omvang en inhoud hiervan.

title: Verslaggeving door pensioenfondsen over de pensioentransitie
abstractText: Dit artikel beschrijft onderzoek naar de wijze waarop pensioenfondsen in hun jaarverslag 2025 verantwoording afleggen over de transitie naar de nieuwe Wet toekomst pensioenen, inclusief invaren. Op basis van een analyse van 30 jaarverslagen worden de verslaggevingstechnische verwerking en de verantwoording over gebeurtenissen na balansdatum, de verdeling van het fondsvermogen, de invaarbonus, de evenwichtige belangenafweging en ontvangen klachten onderzocht. De boekhoudkundige verwerking is overwegend inzichtelijk en vrijwel alle fondsen presenteren een waterval van de vermogensverdeling waarmee de invaarbonus berekend kan worden. De meeste fondsen verantwoorden de belangenafweging zowel procesmatig als inhoudelijk. Het artikel eindigt met vier suggesties om de praktijk verder te verbeteren.

title: Pengembangan User Interface Verifikasi Klaim Jaminan Kesehatan Nasional Dalam Rekam Kesehatan Elektronik di RSPON Mahar Mardjono Jakarta
abstractText: The verification process of National Health Insurance (JKN) claims in hospitals requires an efficient information system to minimize coding errors and pending claims. The JKN claim process at RSPON Mahar Mardjono Jakarta remains suboptimal due to the automatic transfer of all diagnosis data from the Electronic Health Record (EHR) to E-Klaim, requiring manual deletion of inappropriate data and additional recording by coders. This study aimed to develop a user interface (UI) for JKN claim verification in the EHR based on user needs. This study employed a Research and Development (R&D) method with an Activity-Centered Design (ACD) approach. Data collection was conducted at the requirements stage through observation of the EHR system and coder activities, as well as interviews with five JKN coders. The design stage produced a UI prototype using Figma, which was implemented as an interactive prototype and evaluated using Heuristic Evaluation by expert evaluators. Data analysis was conducted qualitatively to identify user needs and problems, and quantitatively using severity rating to assess usability. The results showed a UI prototype with diagnosis validation checkboxes, justification fields, and automated verification reports.

title: Perbandingan IndoBERT dan mBERT Untuk Klasifikasi Toksisitas Pada Chat Roblox dan Minecraft Berbahasa Indonesia
abstractText: Toxic chat in online games exposes young players to harassment, while moderation of Indonesian chat is hampered by slang and non-standard spelling. This study compares monolingual IndoBERT and multilingual mBERT for four-class toxicity classification (neutral, violence, racist, harassment) of Indonesian Roblox and Minecraft chat to identify the more suitable model for moderation. Both models were fine-tuned with identical settings on the Indonesian Chat Dataset (10,702 chats) using three seeds, and evaluated with accuracy, macro-averaged precision, recall, F1-score, and McNemar’s test. IndoBERT reached a mean macro F1-score of 0.8541 ± 0.0019 versus 0.8263 ± 0.0090 for mBERT, significant in two of three seeds. Neutral was the hardest class, and IndoBERT let 5.8% of toxic chats pass as neutral versus 8.3% for mBERT. Excluding 106 duplicated test chats did not change the ranking. Under these settings, IndoBERT performed better, although labels lack inter-annotator agreement and data cover two games only.

title: Pengaruh Belanja Pemerintah Bidang Pendidikan, Kesehatan, dan Perlindungan Sosial Terhadap Indeks Pembangunan Manusia Kabupaten/Kota di Provinsi Gorontalo
abstractText: This study examines statistical associations between government expenditure on education, health, and social protection and the Human Development Index (HDI) in six districts/municipalities of Gorontalo Province over 2019–2023. A balanced panel of 30 observations is estimated using a fixed-effects model selected through Chow and Hausman tests. Education expenditure has a positive but statistically insignificant coefficient (β = 2.146823; p = 0.2478). Health expenditure (β = −1.320577; p = 0.0476) and social protection expenditure (β = −2.180624; p < 0.001) have negative statistical associations. The adjusted R² of 0.988012 reflects the explanatory power of the entire model, including district fixed effects, rather than the three expenditure variables alone. The observational design does not establish causality, and negative coefficients should not be interpreted as evidence that increasing expenditure reduces HDI. Further assessment of spending quality and robustness is required.

title: Ускорение разработки программного обеспечения с применением генеративного искусственного интеллекта: преимущества и ограничения
abstractText: В статье рассматривается влияние генеративного искусственного интеллекта на скорость создания программного обеспечения. На основе сравнительного анализа научных исследований сопоставлены возможности ускорения написания кода и ограничения, возникающие на этапах проверки, тестирования и интеграции изменений. Показано, что сокращение времени реализации отдельных функций не всегда приводит к сопоставимому уменьшению общего срока разработки. Обоснована необходимость оценки производительности с учётом качества программного продукта и совокупных затрат на его создание.

title: Системная модель развития дистрибуции FMCG-производителя: опыт выхода в федеральные и региональные торговые сети
abstractText: В статье исследуются механизмы и алгоритмы формирования многоканальной дистрибуции новых продуктовых категорий на зрелых FMCG-рынках с высоким уровнем конкуренции и жесткими барьерами входа. На примере практического кейса компании ООО «Трейдберри» (бренд «Вкусы мира» под руководством В. Шевченко) разбирается эволюционная методология системного листинга кондитерских и чайных линеек в федеральных и региональных розничных сетях, а также в e-grocery сегменте на горизонте семи лет. Авторы препарируют комбинацию стратегии дифференциации («Голубой океан»), организации контрактного производства и поэтапного построения каналов продаж. Продемонстрировано, как инновационные форматы (манговые и фруктовые шарики, ломтики без добавления сахара, экзотическая чайная группа) позволяют минимизировать риски ротации за счет управления оборачиваемостью (Sales Velocity) и соблюдения жестких требований к уровню сервиса (Fill Rate). Показатели роста выручки и рентабельности приведены в относительном выражении (индексы и темпы прироста), предложена практическая матрица каналов продаж.

title: Expedited partner therapy uptake and STI clearance among cisgender women in a prospective study in Kenya
abstractText: BACKGROUND: We examined factors associated with expedited partner therapy (EPT) uptake and clearance of Chlamydia trachomatis (CT) and/or Neisseria gonorrhoeae (NG) among women taking HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) in Kenya. METHODS: We conducted a nested analysis of cisgender women enrolled in the dPEP Kenya Study (N=449) who tested positive for CT and/or NG during quarterly testing over one year. Following each positive test, participants received treatment, were offered optional EPT, and returned for a test of cure 2-4 weeks later. Baseline characteristics were compared between participants with and without EPT uptake using chi-square tests. Generalized estimating equation models assessed visit-level correlates of EPT uptake and test-of-cure outcomes while accounting for repeated infections over time. RESULTS: Among 140 participants with CT or NG infection at 209 study visits, 75% (n=105) accepted EPT at least once. Women who accepted EPT were more likely to have an independent income (61.9% p=0.018) and report recent transactional sex (54.3%, p=0.032). At the visit level, having a primary sex partner was positively associated with EPT uptake (OR=2.17, 95% CI=1.01-4.65, p=0.047). Intimate partner violence was associated with lower EPT uptake in multivariable analysis (OR=0.23, 95% CI=0.06-0.95, p=0.042). EPT uptake was not significantly associated with a negative test-of-cure result (OR=2.42, 95% CI=0.89-6.56, p=0.082). CONCLUSIONS: EPT uptake was high among women taking PrEP in Kenya. While partner and relationship factors influenced uptake, EPT was not significantly associated with STI clearance at test of cure.

title: Pengaruh Pengalaman Pengguna dan Persepsi Keamanan terhadap Kepuasan Pengguna QRIS dengan Frekuensi Penggunaan sebagai Variabel Moderasi pada Kedai Kopi Langit Society Medan
abstractText: This study aims to evaluate the effects of User Experience and Perceived Security on User Satisfaction with the QRIS digital payment service, with Frequency of Use as a moderating variable, at Kedai Kopi Langit Society Medan. The research employs a quantitative method using a survey of 150 respondents selected through purposive sampling. The data were analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with the assistance of SmartPLS 4. The results show an R-Square value of 0.536, meaning that 53.6% of the variance in User Satisfaction can be explained by the model. User Experience (β = 0.465; t = 8.374), Perceived Security (β = 0.364; t = 6.106), and Frequency of Use (β = 0.190; t = 3.538) each have a positive and significant effect on User Satisfaction. Frequency of Use was also found to moderate the relationship between User Experience (β = 0.123) and Perceived Security (β = 0.215) and User Satisfaction. These findings indicate that frequency of use strengthens these relationships. From a practical perspective, the results provide insights for the management of Kedai Kopi Langit Society and digital payment service providers to enhance user satisfaction through efficient, fast, convenient, and secure transaction processes, while maintaining the reliability of the QRIS system.

title: Klasifikasi Kualitas Karet Menggunakan Metode Random Forest Pada Perusahaan XYZ
abstractText: Company XYZ, a crumb rubber processor in Sumatra, Indonesia, assigns each production lot a Low, Medium, or High quality category by laboratory testing, but recorded parameters are not linked to them. This study tests how well Random Forest reproduces the categories from six parameters in 1,031 lots, only 13.5% of which are Low. Random Forest was compared with Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, and two naive baselines using hold-out, repeated, and nested cross-validation. Cross-validated macro-F1 of the tuned Random Forest was 0.409, higher than Decision Tree (0.365; p = 0.028) and not significantly different from SVM (0.385; p = 0.13), yet only slightly above random guessing (0.330). No model exceeded the accuracy of always guessing High (0.507), and the Low class fared worst (F1 about 0.23). The six parameters barely differ between classes, so the data carry little class information. The model suits only flagging lots for laboratory re-testing.

title: Properties of chromium and manganese in Tycho's supernova remnant with XRISM/Resolve
abstractText: The X-ray emission of young supernova remnants (SNRs) gives access to the composition and spatial distribution of elements ejected in supernovae. The emission from the ejecta provides crucial insights into the explosion mechanism, especially for Fe-group elements formed in the innermost layers of the star. The objective of this paper is to provide constraints on the supernova progenitor and explosion mechanism of Tycho's type Ia supernova remnant by studying the properties of Cr and Mn. We analyzed /Resolve high-resolution X-ray spectroscopy observations of five regions of Tychos's supernova remnant, which were performed during the performance-verification phase and the AO1 phase. Gaussian line modeling was first used to determine the spatial distribution and intensity of Cr and Mn Kα lines. We then modeled the emission of the Cr, Mn and Fe plasma in each pointing with two nonequilibrium ionization shock models to reproduce both the front- and rear-emitting sides of the shocked ejecta shell. Mass ratios of Cr/Fe, Mn/Fe, and Mn/Cr are compared with expectations from different Type Ia supernova models from 1D and 3D numerical simulations. XRISM The unprecedented spectral resolution of /Resolve allows us to detect significant emission lines of Cr and Mn in different regions of Tycho's supernova remnant, even on small scales, providing a much more precise spatial distribution of Cr and Mn with respect to previous measurements. Significant Cr and Mn emission lines are observed in the Fe-bright northeastern-to-southeastern emitting rim; some are observed in the center region, but none in the southern region. The observed mass ratios of Mn/Fe, Cr/Fe, and Mn/Cr, are consistent with 1D delayed detonation models of near-Chandrasekhar-mass Type Ia supernovae and 1D pure-detonation models of 1 M_⊙ sub-Chandrasekhar-mass progenitors. In both cases, the observations imply supersolar zero-age main-sequence progenitor metallicities. XRISM Overall, the best agreement is found for models with metallicities too high to be realistic for Tycho's location. This points to additional sources of neutronization such as carbon simmering for a Chandrasekhar-mass progenitor. For sub-Chandrasekhar-mass, double-detonation models with a white-dwarf mass lower than 1M_⊙ are suggested.

title: Peran Self-Control Dalam Memoderasi Pengaruh Lifestyle dan User Experience Terhadap Impulsive Buying Pada Generasi Z Pengguna Shopee
abstractText: Impulsive buying among Generation Z on Shopee is influenced by lifestyle and user experience; however, previous findings are inconsistent, and the role of self-control as a moderator has not been tested together with both factors. This study aims to analyze the role of self-control in moderating the effects of lifestyle and user experience on impulsive buying among Generation Z on Shopee. The study employs an associative-causal quantitative approach with purposive sampling of 100 active Generation Z Shopee users. Data were analyzed using PLS-SEM (SmartPLS 4), complemented by ANOVA (F-test) to examine the simultaneous effects. The results show that lifestyle and user experience have positive and significant effects on impulsive buying, both partially and simultaneously together with self-control and its two interactions (F = 12.325; p < 0.001). Self-control has a negative and significant effect and negatively and significantly moderates the effects of lifestyle and user experience, thereby weakening both relationships. The novelty of this study lies in its integrated model, which simultaneously examines lifestyle and user experience with self-control as a moderator. The better Generation Z's self-control, the lower the tendency toward impulsive buying, even when influenced by lifestyle and an engaging online shopping experience. These findings are expected to provide insights for consumers and e-commerce platform managers in understanding and managing purchasing behavior.

title: FILOS: A solar filament oscillation simulator
abstractText: Solar filament oscillations provide diagnostics of prominence structure and stability, but methods for recovering their physical properties require validation against observations for which the filament geometry and dynamics are known. We present FILOS, a solar filament oscillation simulator that generates synthetic filaments with prescribed oscillatory motions in Hα observations representative of the Global Oscillation Network Group (GONG). Filament morphology is constructed from measured spines and populated with three-dimensional dipped threads. Each thread follows a circular magnetic dip and contains hydrostatic prominence plasma, from which the Hα optical depth is computed. The filament is projected onto the image plane, degraded according to the GONG instrumental response, and superimposed on observed GONG Hα background sequences. Longitudinal and transverse damped motions can be imposed independently. Longitudinal periods can be prescribed or computed for each thread from the dip curvature and prominence height using the pendulum model. FILOS produces GONG-like Hα sequences with filament geometry and dynamics known by construction. In a representative longitudinal experiment, the thread periods span 44.2--87.6 min (median 60.8 min). Standard-normalized Lomb–Scargle power maps reveal the dominant period and the expected period-halving signature near equilibrium. A time--distance fit recovers an onset of 19.53 min for a prescribed 20 min and a collective period of 57.71 min. Differences between the fitted collective quantities and the nominal thread-level inputs are consistent with the effects of projection, image formation, and progressive thread dephasing. FILOS also provides segmentation masks and opacity-weighted plane-of-sky velocity fields. FILOS provides a controlled framework for testing how prescribed filament dynamics map onto GONG-like Hα observables enabling validation of oscillation-analysis methods, assessment of observational biases, and generation of labeled datasets for segmentation and motion-estimation applications.

title: Artificial intelligence in dermatology: a present reality, not the future
AI-Assisted Analysis of Horse Color Symbolism in the Jangar Epic
abstractText: This study examines the symbolic significance of horse coat colors in the Jangar epic through a comparative analysis of artificial intelligence interpretation and traditional scholarly perspectives. Using ChatGPT-4 with systematic prompt design and natural language processing (NLP) techniques, we analyzed the frequency and symbolic meanings of horse coat colors in the 27-chapter Kalmyk version of the epic. The AI-generated interpretations were systematically compared with the scholarly work of S. Dulam and D. Bat on Mongolian color symbolism. Our methodology involved three distinct phases: (1) NLP-based frequency analysis of horse coat color mentions, (2) structured AI interpretation using documented prompts, and (3) comparative analysis with established ethnographic research. Results reveal that while AI effectively identifies general associations of strength, power, and character traits, it shows limited capacity to capture the deep socio-cultural, historical, and hierarchical contexts present in traditional Mongolian scholarship. Significant interpretive differences emerged in the symbolism of blue, red, and spotted horses. The study demonstrates that AI tools, while valuable for pattern recognition and preliminary analysis, require substantial enrichment with ethnographic and linguistic data to comprehend the nuanced symbolic systems in Mongolian oral traditions. This research contributes methodologically to digital humanities by establishing a framework for combining computational text analysis with traditional folklore studies, while identifying specific limitations and opportunities for AI application in cultural heritage research.

title: A Latin American expert consensus on diagnostic and therapeutic approach for the most common vascular anomalies
abstractText: Background: Vascular anomalies (VA) include vascular malformations and tumors. The International Society for the Study of Vascular Anomalies (ISSVA) classification provides the international framework for their study and management; however, the low prevalence of these entities and the frequent misuse of terminology contribute to errors in diagnosis and management. Objective: To perform an expert consensus via nominal technique to generate diagnostic and therapeutic flowcharts for the most common VA. Material and methods: A consensus study was conducted using nominal group technique by an international panel of 17 VA experts. An extensive review of the literature and the 2025 ISSVA classification were performed, and during four meetings the proposed flowcharts were thoroughly discussed, reviewed, and validated until general agreement was achieved. Results: Six flowcharts were developed for infantile hemangioma, high-flow vascular malformations (VaM), low-flow capillary VaM, low-flow lymphatic VaM, low-flow venous VaM, and syndromic combined VaM. Each flowchart integrates clinical criteria, etiology, diagnostic approach, treatment, and follow-up, as color-coded sections. Conclusions: This study provides practical tools to facilitate accurate diagnostic and therapeutic decision-making in patients with VA, including a clinically applicable format for daily practice, providing a foundation for future validation and updates. These flowcharts as continuing medical education resources will favour the correct diagnosis and appropriate management of patients with VA.
