title: Cioccolato fondente: il buono dell’amaro
abstractText: Il cioccolato fondente, ottenuto da cacao e burro di cacao con quote ridotte di zucchero, è il tipo di cioccolato a cui si attribuiscono i maggiori effetti sulla salute, per l’elevato contenuto di polifenoli, flavanoli e procianidine. Nonostante un mercato in espansione e consumi molto variabili tra paesi europei, il gusto prevalente in Italia resta quello del cioccolato al latte. Meta-analisi di studi randomizzati indicano effetti favorevoli, ma di piccola entità, sulla pressione arteriosa, sullo stress ossidativo e sull’infiammazione e possibili benefici su alcune funzioni cognitive. La trasformazione delle fave (fermentazione, tostatura, raffinazione, concaggio) riduce in modo marcato il contenuto di polifenoli e per questo è oggetto di ricerche che puntano ad arricchire il prodotto con ingredienti funzionali. Gli studi epidemiologici sull’uomo sono ancora insufficienti per definire dose, modalità e tempi di consumo. Il cioccolato, noto da oltre cinquemila anni, conserva il suo valore culturale e gastronomico, come ricorda il nome Theobroma cacao, «cibo degli dei».

title: Student Self-Care for Health: Practices, Motives, Typology
abstractText: Drawing on sociological interview data, the article explores the characteristics of practices of students’ self-care for health. It argues that students incorporate health care practices into their daily lives, supporting physical, mental, and social well-being. The core practices include physical activity, a balanced diet, and adherence to a daily routine; disease prevention occupies a leading position in the motivational structure. The typology of health care practices is identified based on the following criteria: the functional content of practices (practices aimed at caring for physical, mental, and social health); the goals of the actors engaging in these practices (health care practices focused on prevention and treatment), the structure of everyday life and lifestyle (practic-es of incorporating health-saving actions into one’s lifestyle and practices of avoiding health-risk behaviors), and the form in which the data on the body’s condition are recorded and verified (traditional [analogue] practic-es and innovative [digital] healthcare practices). Recommendations are proposed for fostering practices for health care and ensuring their reproduction in everyday life.

title: A new species of Carmenta Hy. Edwards (Lepidoptera: Sesiidae) and Osminia (Aegeria) candescens (Edwards, 1882) reinstated as a valid species from Arizona
abstractText: A new clearwing moth species, Carmenta mogollon sp. nov. is described from Arizona. The recognition of this new species is based on a phylogeny estimated from mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase I of 84 sesiid species including individuals from various locations. Carmenta mogollon sp. nov. was monophyletic and differed from Carmenta wellerae Duckworth & Eichlin,1976 and Carmenta arizonae (Beutenmüller, 1898) by 0.032–0.033 COI pairwise “p” distance, coloration, and genitalic morphology. In addition, Osminia candescens (Hy. Edwards, 1882) is reinstated as a valid species from southern Arizona and it differs from Osminia ruficornis (Hy. Edwards, 1882) from Oklahoma and Kansas by 0.074–0.081 COI pairwise “p” distance.

title: Fourier-Enhanced In-Context Transformers for Generalizable PDE Operator Learning
abstractText: Surrogate models for parametric PDEs require generalization across varying conditions. In-context operator networks (ICON) achieve this via prompting. However, standard ICON tokenizes raw spatial samples, leading to quadratic self-attention costs and weak inductive biases for spectral decay and long-range physics. We propose F-ICON, a Fourier-enhanced Transformer that injects a global spectral prior into PDE operator learning. It replaces standard tokenization with a lightweight Fourier Neural Operator (FNO), producing globally informed features. These features are processed by an ICON encoder with residual spectral fusion and decoded via cross-attention to predict solutions at arbitrary coordinates. Tested under matched conditions on the 1D viscous Burgers equation, 2D Darcy flow, and regularized cavity flow, F-ICON significantly improves accuracy and stability. Compared with standard ICON, F-ICON reduces the mean relative $L^2$ error by 59.2%, 74.9%, and 11.6% on the Burgers, Darcy-flow, and regularized cavity-flow benchmarks, respectively. In the three-seed cavity-flow study, F-ICON consistently lowers the seed-level mean, 90th percentile, and maximum joint velocity errors, indicating more stable average and high-error performance across random initializations. Results demonstrate that Fourier-preconditioned context encoding provides a robust path to more accurate and generalizable in-context PDE operator learning.

title: An Analysis of Teachers’ Readiness to Implement the Deep Learning Approach at Madrasah Aliyah Swasta Tarbiyah Islamiah Batang Kabung
abstractText: The Deep Learning approach in the Merdeka Curriculum calls for teachers to design mindful, meaningful, and joyful learning experiences. Preliminary findings at Tarbiyah Islamiah Private Islamic Senior High School (MAS TI) Batang Kabung indicated differences in how teachers understood and applied the approach. This descriptive qualitative study examined teachers’ readiness to implement Deep Learning across four competency domains (pedagogical, professional, personal, and social). Five purposively selected teachers of chemistry, Indonesian, English, informatics, and history served as primary informants, with additional perspectives from the principal, the vice principal for curriculum affairs, and students. Data from semi-structured interviews, non-participant observations, and instructional modules were analyzed using the Miles and Huberman model, and findings were checked through triangulation across sources and methods. Pedagogical readiness was evident in teachers’ attention to students’ learning needs and instructional planning. Professional readiness was reflected in subject-matter mastery and an emerging understanding of Deep Learning. Personal readiness was evident in openness to change and a sense of responsibility, while social readiness was reflected in constructive communication with students and collaboration with colleagues. Teachers showed readiness across all four domains, with differences particularly evident in how they assessed prior knowledge, promoted equitable participation, developed context-specific materials, and incorporated reflection on learning. These differences give Islamic schools specific areas to assess and address through ongoing professional development, instructional mentoring, and collaboration among teachers.

Seismic response of a thermoelastic gas-bearing seabed sediment layer induced by obliquely incident P waves
abstractText: Purpose This study aims to investigate the seismic response of a thermoelastic gas-bearing seabed sediment layer subjected to obliquely incident P waves, focusing on thermo-mechanical coupling and sediment properties. Design/methodology/approach A seawater–gas-bearing sediment–bedrock model is established using the wave theories of ideal fluids, unsaturated porous thermoelastic media and single-phase thermoelastic media. Wave fields are formulated using potential functions and analytical solutions are obtained by imposing interface continuity conditions. Parametric analyses examine the effects of incident angle, temperature, saturation, frequency, sediment thickness, porosity and thermal properties. Findings Thermo-mechanical coupling substantially modifies the wave propagation behavior and dynamic amplification mechanisms of gas-bearing seabed sediments. The horizontal displacement initially increases and subsequently decreases with increasing incident angle, whereas the vertical displacement generally decreases. As saturation increases, the overall displacement response at the seabed surface decreases; meanwhile, the horizontal amplification is enhanced, whereas the vertical amplification is weakened. The dynamic response and displacement amplification factor of the gas-bearing sediment layer exhibit clear frequency dependence. With increasing sediment layer thickness, the vertical response exhibits quasi-periodic oscillations. Originality/value This study incorporates thermoelastic effects into the seismic analysis of a seawater–gas-bearing sediment–bedrock system. The proposed analytical framework clarifies the coupled effects of heat conduction, multiphase characteristics and sediment properties on wave propagation and displacement amplification in submarine sediments.

title: Structure–property relationships in bis(2-amino-5-methyl-1,3-thiazol-3-ium) fumarate: crystal chemistry, supramolecular assembly and electronic structure
abstractText: Single crystals of bis(2-amino-5-methyl-1,3-thiazol-3-ium) fumarate (BMTI–FUM) were synthesized and structurally characterized using single-crystal X-ray diffraction, spectroscopic, thermal and quantum-chemical methods. The compound crystallizes in the triclinic space group P 1 ̅ $̅{1}$ with Z = 4, where proton transfer from fumaric acid to the thiazole nitrogen generates a charge-assisted iminium–carboxylate assembly. The crystal packing is governed by strong charge-assisted N–H⋯O hydrogen bonds that link the ionic components into an extended supramolecular framework. Hirshfeld surface analysis and two-dimensional fingerprint plots confirm that H⋯H (40.4 %) and O⋯H/H⋯O (22.1 %) contacts dominate the packing environment. Powder X-ray diffraction verifies bulk phase purity. Optical measurements reveal a cut-off wavelength near 305 nm and an optical band gap of 3.92 eV, while fluorescence emission is centred at 402 nm. Thermal analysis indicates structural stability up to approximately 242 °C. Density functional calculations yield a HOMO–LUMO separation of 2.53 eV and reveal complementary electronic distributions between the thiazolium cations and fumarate dianion. Interaction-energy calculations demonstrate that electrostatic contributions associated with charge-assisted hydrogen bonding dominate the crystal packing. The combined experimental and theoretical results clarify the role of charge-assisted hydrogen bonding and electronic delocalization in directing the structural organization and electronic characteristics of BMTI–FUM.

title: Pengembangan Keterampilan Pemasaran Siswa sebagai Upaya Meningkatkan Kesiapan SDM di Dunia Kerja
abstractText: Lulusan sekolah menengah masih menghadapi kesenjangan antara keterampilan yang dimiliki dan kebutuhan dunia kerja; Badan Pusat Statistik mencatat tingkat pengangguran terbuka lulusan SMK pada Februari 2026 sebesar 7,74 persen, tertinggi dibandingkan jenjang pendidikan lainnya. Keterampilan pemasaran, komunikasi, dan literasi digital dibutuhkan hampir di semua bidang usaha. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan meningkatkan keterampilan pemasaran siswa SMA PGRI Rangkasbitung, Kabupaten Lebak, Banten, melalui pelatihan dan workshop dasar pemasaran, komunikasi dan personal selling, serta pemasaran digital melalui media sosial. Metode pelaksanaan meliputi survei dan pra-survei, ceramah interaktif, praktik kelompok menyusun rencana pemasaran dan konten promosi, simulasi penjualan (pitching), serta evaluasi menggunakan pre-test, post-test, dan angket berdasarkan empat tingkat evaluasi Kirkpatrick. Kegiatan dilaksanakan oleh mahasiswa Program Studi Manajemen, PSDKU Kampus Kota Serang, Universitas Pamulang, dan diikuti sekitar 50 siswa. Hasilnya, kenaikan rata-rata skor post-test terhadap pre-test memenuhi target minimal 20 persen, setiap kelompok menghasilkan satu rencana pemasaran dan satu konten promosi, seluruh kelompok tampil dalam simulasi pitching, dan lima penampil terbaik memperoleh penghargaan. Peserta memberikan tanggapan positif dan sebagian siswa mulai mengunggah konten promosi. Kegiatan ini menunjukkan bahwa pelatihan pemasaran yang partisipatif efektif meningkatkan keterampilan dan kesiapan kerja siswa.

title: A new generic synonymy and three new combinations in Hyperbaenus Brunner von Wattenwyl, 1888 (Orthoptera: Stenopelmatoidea: Gryllacrididae)
abstractText: The generic placement of three Brazilian gryllacridids, Dasylistroscelis neivai Mello-Leitao, 1940, Gryllacris (Gryllacris) piracicabae Piza, 1975, and Gryllacris (Gryllacris) vicosae Piza, 1975, is reassessed based on their original descriptions and photographs of their holotypes. Comparisons with Hyperbaenus Brunner von Wattenwyl, 1888 and other Neotropical gryllacridid genera support the following new combinations: Hyperbaenus neivai (Mello-Leitao, 1940) comb. nov., H. piracicabae (Piza, 1975) comb. nov., and H. vicosae (Piza, 1975) comb. nov. The monotypic genus Dasylistroscelis Mello-Leitao, 1940 is proposed as a junior synonym of Hyperbaenus.
